Guidance & outlook: Krishna Rao Independent Director Steel City Securities Limited 32nd Annual Report 2025-26 7 Message From the Chairman Dear Esteemed Shareholders, I am honored to present a comprehensive overview of our financial performance and strategic initiatives for FY 2025-26.
During much of the fiscal year, markets were supported by the strong macroeconomic backdrop, with FY26 real GDP growing at an estimated 7.6%.
We have set an ambitious target to reach over 70,000+ e-Governance centers by FY 2026-27.
Growth & demand: Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) remained key stabilizing forces, During this period, the Indian capital market stood at a pivotal juncture-marked by growth, innovation, and evolving dynamics.
Continued emphasis on technological advancement, strengthening of regulatory frameworks, and a focus on sustainable growth have further reinforced the market's long-term potential.
Corporate Earnings and Economic Growth Corporate earnings have gradually aligned with realistic growth expectations, contributing to more sustainable valuations.
Margins & costs: In 2026, the focus remains on balancing inflation control with growth stimulation, ensuring a stable monetary environment conducive to investment and consumption.
